name: isGroupMembershipChangeAudited
definition: True when JumpCloud's directory-events read for the lookback window contains at least one group-membership or association event. This is an ACTIVITY PROXY: a tenant where no membership changed in the window reads false although auditing is on. Not measured when the read hit its page limit with no matching event.
population: directory events returned for the queried lookback window
evidenceRequiredForTrue: at least one directory event whose event_type or association field shows a group-membership change in the window
citations: safeguards/identity-and-access-management/jumpcloud/isGroupMembershipChangeAudited.py: matching_count > 0 rule and the PAGE_LIMIT guard

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the registry gate can fail push runs on main; proposed, single emitter. Recorded as an activity proxy, the same shape that made isIAMLoggingEnabled contested; flagged for the owner.
